title: Decision: FIPS gate checked per-operation, not only at session init
description: fips_gate() is checked at every crypto entry point (write/update, read/finalize, sign, verify, agree, set_iv, gen_iv) not only at INIT time. This is correct: wolfCrypt's FIPS status can change at runtime (POST re-run failure, integrity check failure). An operation that started on a healthy session might reach the provider code in a degraded FIPS state. FIPS 140-3 requires operational-time checks, not only initialization-time. A reviewer suggesting 'check once at INIT — the session's state is already gated' is wrong about the FIPS operational requirement.
